duration_policy: Prospective 75 s FOLLOW for all condition extensions, matching the new 75 s core so paired comparisons retain equal duration. This is a task-protocol change, not an algorithm improvement. Original shutter/reselection times, safety gates and complete evaluation denominators remain unchanged. Preserve historical 45 s outcomes and bytes separately; formal admission requires actual 75 s measurements for all 12 core and 16 extension development cells and a fresh physical-volume capacity budget, without deleting original evidence to conceal insufficient space.
sampling_policy: A separate 160-slot final-Humble matrix, not part of the unchanged 120-slot core denominator. Each condition has both classes and ten seeds. Freeze this complete protocol before the first core or extension held-out flight; reference_group plus class/seed prospectively names the paired clean core slot. Never select, replace or retry a slot after viewing outcomes.
flight_policy: Use the same frozen flight sources, models, runtime, CPU renderer, PX4 source clock, native takeoff, safety gates, duration, controller and explicit shutter/reselection policy as the final core plan. Sensor fault parameters and motion profiles come from the hashed run_stage1_trial implementation. Only the named condition, speed_changes profile, position-mode reference, or declared far distance changes.
failure_policy: Each formal slot once. Keep FAIL, INTERRUPTED, missing evidence and all denominators. Infrastructure stops require a separate diagnosis before remaining pending slots, not a retry.
analysis_policy: Compare each extension to its named same-class/same-seed clean reference using per-trial paired differences, disclose finite-pair n out of ten, all failures and missing evidence. Do not pool historical Jazzy extension outcomes into this Humble study. The far-distance comparison changes the physical setpoint intentionally and does not claim identical camera views.
